messages:
alex_support: Hey billing team — customer acme-corp (acct: acct_01A3) reports month-end mismatch. Dashboard shows 12,945 tokens for Feb 28 window, invoice line totals 14,210 tokens. Can we cross-check? Suspect short embedding microbursts from nightly embedding job that ran ~00:12 UTC on 2024-02-29.

maria_finance: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the invoice id and plan tier? Also which invoice period? :thinking_face:

alex_support: invoice INV-20240228-ACME, plan: pro-monthly, billing window Feb 1–28. Customer says dashboard cutoff 00:00 UTC but invoice includes events up to 00:15 UTC. Attached their export snippet:

alex_support: ```
account: acct_01A3
period_start: 2024-02-01
period_end: 2024-02-28 00:00:00 UTC
dashboard_total_tokens: 12945
invoice_total_tokens: 14210
```

tanvi_billing: Hmm, could be late ingestion/backfill. Did any backfill job or retry run around 00:00–00:30 UTC? Also check for embed_batch jobs that do deduping differently.

ops_bot: deploybot: deployed embedding-worker v2.1.4 to eu-west-1 at 2024-02-29T00:08:12Z

sam_engineer: Repro step — run this query against metering_raw_events to compare aggregator vs invoice:

sam_engineer: ```sql
-- tokens per ingestion type
select event_type, sum(token_count) as tokens
from metering_raw_events
where account_id = 'acct_01A3'
  and event_ts >= '2024-02-28T23:50:00Z'
  and event_ts < '2024-02-29T00:30:00Z'
group by 1;
```

sam_engineer: Also run aggregator view used by dashboard:

sam_engineer: ```sql
select sum(tokens) from dashboard_token_agg where account_id='acct_01A3' and day='2024-02-28';
```

maria_finance: If raw_events sum ~= invoice_total and dashboard sum ~= dashboard_total, then invoice included events after cutoff. If that's true, we can either credit or re-run invoice cutoff aggregation. Need engineering sign-off.

tanvi_billing: Can someone paste sample rows showing microburst pattern? I'm worried small high-frequency jobs might be counted twice by invoice process if retries were logged as separate events.

alex_support: Pasted two matching raw rows from customer export:

alex_support: ```
2024-02-29T00:09:05Z, embed_batch, tokens=620
2024-02-29T00:09:06Z, embed_batch, tokens=612
```

sam_engineer: Those timestamps fall after 00:00 UTC. The dashboard agg window truncates by day boundary (end exclusive). Invoice ingestion window currently uses ingestion_time which had delay. Need to check whether invoice pipeline used event_ts or ingestion_time.

ops_bot: billing-alert: invoice-run for 2024-02-28 completed at 2024-02-29T01:12Z

sam_engineer: Quick check — run:

sam_engineer: ```sql
select used_field, sum(token_count) from invoice_ingest_events
where invoice_id='INV-20240228-ACME' group by used_field;
```

tanvi_billing: If invoice used ingestion_time, late events would be included. If that's the bug, we should patch and issue credit for delta (~1,265 tokens). Recommend temporary fix: adjust invoice to use event_ts aligned to cutoff and schedule a one-off refund/credit.

maria_finance: Approved provisional credit if engineering confirms spammy duplicate retries. Please attach reconciliation snapshot and delta.

alex_support: Will run queries now and upload CSV. Will loop back with a reconciliation table and recommended credit amount. Thanks all :pray:

sam_engineer: FYI I'll open an action item in eng-platform to ensure invoice ingestion uses event_ts for cutoff and add a quick unit test to prevent regression.

tanvi_billing: Filed billing ticket BLG-4132 to track customer credit and root cause.

alex_support: Closing loop for now — uploading CSV to thread: https://redwood.internal/attachments/recon-acct_01A3-feb.csv

maria_finance: Thanks — will review and confirm credit on Monday.
